title: A Moment
author: Tahera Mannan
text:
A moment dropped from the basket of time
And went to pay its many debts
Life quietly awaited it
Pain needed to be healed
Hearts needed to be joined
Duty cried for fulfillment
A smile no time to spread
Desire danced on darkened streets
Work tired, sat around
Honour, Duty dueled away
Relations just fell apart
The moment picked those heartstrings up
No music came no love sang
I went to look for the fallen moment
And found an entire saga of Faith
The Moment lost forever.
